# Kamod UI

**Kamod UI** is a lightweight set of accessible, composable UI components for **Preact** and **Tailwind CSS v4**. It is designed for teams who want source they can read, adapt, and ship without a heavy runtime.

## Overview

- [Homepage / Demo](https://ui.kamod.ch/)
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/kamod-ch/kamod-ui)
- [npm package `@kamod-ch/ui`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kamod-ch/ui)
- [README](https://github.com/kamod-ch/kamod-ui/blob/main/README.md)
- [Component size + signals reference](https://github.com/kamod-ch/kamod-ui/blob/main/.docs/COMPONENTS.md)
- [Contributing notes](https://github.com/kamod-ch/kamod-ui/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Security policy](https://github.com/kamod-ch/kamod-ui/blob/main/SECURITY.md)

## Quick start

Install:

```bash
pnpm add @kamod-ch/ui preact @preact/signals tailwindcss
```

Import the default theme once:

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@kamod-ch/ui/theme.css";
```

Use a component:

```tsx
import { Button } from "@kamod-ch/ui";

export function App() {
  return <Button>Click me</Button>;
}
```

## Requirements

- Preact >= 10.26
- `@preact/signals` >= 2.0
- Tailwind CSS v4
- ESM-compatible bundler
- Package is ESM-only

## Project positioning

Kamod UI is best suited for:

- Preact applications
- Tailwind-first workflows
- teams that want composable primitives instead of a heavy design-system runtime
- projects that prefer readable, adaptable source code

Kamod UI is not aimed at:

- React-only ecosystems that depend on React-specific component kits
- Tailwind-free styling setups
- organizations looking for a large token/CMS-driven design-system platform

## Package usage notes

- Root import is supported: `import { Button } from "@kamod-ch/ui"`
- Per-component subpath imports are supported: `import { Button } from "@kamod-ch/ui/button"`
- Import `@kamod-ch/ui/theme.css` once so Tailwind compiles component classes and semantic tokens
- `@preact/signals` is a required peer dependency, even if you only start with presentational components
- The published package is `@kamod-ch/ui`; the monorepo root and demo app are not published

## Repository structure

- `packages/core/` — published component library
- `packages/docs/` — live demo, docs, and kitchen sink
